name: dsh-openwhale
description: Open Whale — connect your phone to this computer's DeepSeek Harness as a personal-assistant chat, over LAN or the internet.
comment: Zero runtime dependencies on purpose. The harness provides @deepseek-ai/* when a plugin is loaded from a profile; the QR encoder, the WebSocket server and the wire protocol are implemented in-tree (src/qr.mjs, src/ws.mjs, src/protocol.mjs) so the plugin installs by plain copy with no build step and no dependency tree. `src/protocol.mjs` is generated from packages/protocol by `npm run sync:protocol` and checked by test/protocol-copy.test.mjs.
